tip_start_sale_body: Halkan taabo si aad iib u bilowdo. Kaliya iskaan garee barcode-ka, qiimuhuna wuu isku darmi doonaa.
tip_today_summary_body: Tani waxay tusinaysaa waxaad maanta iibisay. Fiiri fiidkii kasta si aad u aragto dakhligaaga.
tip_dash_latest_body: Kuwani waa iibkaagii ugu dambeeyay. Taabo 'Arag dhammaan' si aad dib ugu fiiriso maalmihii hore.
tip_dash_compliance_body: Tani waxay tusinaysaa intee dukaankaagu u diyaar yahay kormeer. Taabo si aad u aragto waxa weli loo baahan yahay.
tip_dash_journey_body: Tani waxay la socotaa horumarkaaga ku aadan dukaan si buuxda sharci ah. Taabo si aad u sii wadto tallaabada xigta.
tip_sales_start_body: Halkan taabo si aad iib u qorto — iskaan garee alaabta, wadartuna way isku darmaysaa.
tip_sales_today_body: Hal eegmo ku arag inta aad maanta iibisay.
tip_sales_weekly_body: Jaantankani wuxuu tusinayaa iibkaaga maalin kasta toddobaadkan, si aad u ogaato maalmaha mashquulka badan.
tip_sales_top_body: Kuwani waa alaabta ugu iibka badan toddobaadkan. Had iyo jeer hayso bakhaarka!
tip_sales_history_body: Halkan taabo si aad u aragto iib kasta maalin kasta oo aad dooratay.
tip_sales_stats_body: Halkan taabo si aad u aragto alaabta ugu iibka badan iyo ta ugu yar, faa'iidada, iyo isbeddellada muddo aad dooratay.
tip_inventory_body: Halkan taabo si aad ugu darto alaab, u tirsato bakhaarka, oo aad u aragto waxa dhammaanaya.
tip_inv_products_body: Halkan taabo si aad ugu darto alaab oo aad u dejiso qiimaha iyo kharashka.
tip_inv_expiry_body: Halkan taabo si aad u aragto alaabta u dhow taariikhda dhicitaanka si aanay waxba u luminin.
tip_inv_counts_body: Tirooyinkani waxay tusinayaan wadarta alaabta, waxa yar, iyo waxa dhacaya.
tip_inv_stocktake_body: Halkan taabo si aad u tirsato waxa dhab ahaan kuyaala alaabaha oo aad u saxdo faraqyada.
tip_inv_suppliers_body: Halkan taabo si aad u keydiso cidda aad ka iibsato, si dib-u-dalabku u fududaado.
tip_stock_scan_title: Si dhakhso ah u hel alaab
tip_stock_scan_body: Halkan taabo si aad u iskaan gariso barcode-ka oo aad si toos ah ugu boodo bakhaarka alaabtaas.
tip_stock_search_body: Halkan ku qor magac ama barcode si aad si toos ah ugu boodo alaab.
tip_stock_tabs_body: U dhex gudub dhammaan alaabta, alaabta yar, iyo alaabta dhowaan dhacaysa.
tip_stock_summary_body: Kuwani waxay tusinayaan wadarta alaabta, waxa yar, waxa dhammaaday, iyo waxa dhacaya.
tip_sd_adjust_title: Ku dar ama ka saar bakhaar
tip_sd_adjust_body: Isticmaal 'Ku dar' marka alaab cusub timaaddo, 'Ka saar'na khasaare ama burbur.
tip_sd_quick_body: Taabo tiro caadi ah si aad si dhakhso ah u buuxiso, ama hoos ku qor mid kaaga gaar ah.
tip_sd_batches_body: Halkan ku dar dufcado leh taariikhahooda dhicitaanka, si Movestock kaaga digo intaanay dhicin.
tip_product_add_body: Halkan taabo si aad ugu darto alaab cusub — sii magac, qiime, iyo barcode.
tip_products_import_body: Halkan taabo si aad si dhakhso ah ugu darto alaab caadi ah adigoon dhammaan qorin.
tip_products_search_body: Halkan ku qor magac ama barcode si aad uga hesho alaab liiskaaga.
tip_products_row_body: Taabo alaab kasta si aad u beddesho magaceeda, qiimaheeda, kharashkeeda, ama bakhaarkeeda.
tip_manage_staff_body: Halkan taabo si aad ugu darto iibiyayaal oo aad mid kasta u siiso PIN si uu u galo.
tip_manage_body: Halkan taabo si aad u aragto tallaabooyinka lagu diiwaan geliyo dukaankaaga oo sharci ka dhigo.
tip_manage_compliance_title: Hubi inaad diyaar u tahay kormeer
tip_manage_compliance_body: Halkan taabo si aad u marto waxa kormeeruhu eegi lahaa.
tip_stat_range_body: Dooro taariikhda bilowga iyo dhammaadka si aad u aragto iibka muddadaas.
tip_stat_tiles_body: Iibka, alaabta la iibiyay, lacagta soo gashay, iyo faa'iidada taariikhaha aad dooratay.
tip_stat_trend_body: Arag sida dakhligaagu u kaco oo u dhaco muddada.
tip_stat_top_title: Alaabta ugu iibka badan iyo ta ugu yar
tip_stat_top_body: Arag alaabta ugu iibka badan — iyo ta aan dhaqaaqin.
tip_stat_pdf_body: Halkan taabo si aad warbixintan u soo dejiso oo aad u wadaagto ama u keydiso.
tip_hist_date_body: Isticmaal fallaadhaha ama kalandarka si aad u doorato maalinta iibkeeda aad rabto inaad aragto.
tip_hist_list_body: Taabo iib kasta si aad u furto oo aad u aragto alaabtii la iibiyay.
tip_hist_totals_body: Tirada iibka, lacagta soo gashay, iyo faa'iidada maalinta aad eegayso.
tip_hist_pdf_body: Soo deji iib bil dhan oo PDF ah si aad u keydiso ama u wadaagto.
tip_low_stock_body: Alaab yar ayaa yaraanaysa. Halkan taabo si aad u hubiso bakhaarka oo aad dib u dalbato.
tip_expiring_body: Alaab qaar waxay u dhowdahay taariikhda dhicitaanka. Halkan taabo si aad u aragto kuwee.
tip_missing_cost_body: Ku dar qiimaha aad ku iibsato alaab kasta si Movestock uu kuu tuso faa'iidadaada. Halkan taabo.
tip_no_sale_body: Maanta iib ma aadan samayn? Halkan taabo si aad mid u qorto — kaliya hal iskaan.
intro_body: Mar kasta i taabo, waxaan ku tusi doonaa sida loo isticmaalo waxa shaashaddaada ku jira. Had iyo jeer halkan ayaan joogaa marka aad caawimo u baahato.
sheet_subtitle: Waxaan ahay Stocky, caawimaadaada. Wax dooro, waxaanan si toos ah u tilmaami doonaa.
sheet_first_open: Cusub halkan? Taabo xariiq kasta hoose, waxaanan ku iftiimin doonaa shaashaddaada si aad u ogaato meeshay si sax ah u taallo.
helper_aria_tip: Caawiyaha Stocky — wax baa dareen u baahan
settings_desc: U ogolow Stocky, caawimaadaada, inuu mararka qaarkood ku tuso astaamaha. Waligaa ma jirto inta iib socdo.
